verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI assistant or model product, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no way to run Claude on your own infrastructure. The desktop, mobile and terminal clients are front-ends to the hosted service, and running models through Amazon Bedrock is a third-party cloud host, not self-hosting. Community comments also note that Claude Code is not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
